description.value: Any shot you make at your Marked quarry treats its cover as one step weaker (greater becomes standard, standard becomes lesser, lesser is ignored), and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus (+3 at Undying tier) to the attack roll to overcome whatever cover remains.

cinderfall.incomplete: Base +2 circumstance bonus to the ranged attack roll vs. your Marked quarry is built (FlatModifier, target:mark:quarry). Two things remain unbuilt: (1) the "downgrade cover by exactly one step" clause -- no precedent found even in real pf2e's hunted-prey cover feats (Targeting/Penetrating Shot do full cover *removal*, not a one-step downgrade), so it stays player-adjudicated text; (2) the tiered escalation (+3 at "Undying") -- that tier name is undefined anywhere in the corpus (see waywarden.vanish-between-blinks.json's note for the full cross-check), left as a decision point rather than guessed.
cinderfall.notSpell: waywarden's class document carries system.spellcasting 0, so this is an ability, not a spell, and convert_class_spells.py declines it by design as a NON_CASTERS owner
